subject: Money
title: Barter and Its Limits
description: Learn Barter and Its Limits in one minute.

hook.text: You have wheat. I have fish. Simple trade—until you don't want fish. Then we're stuck.

buildup.text: Barter requires a double coincidence of wants. Both parties must want what the other has.

discovery.text: Anthropologists found that pure barter societies barely existed. People used credit and gifts instead.

twist.text: The textbook story of barter-then-money is largely a myth. Debt came before coins did.

climax.text: Money didn't replace barter. It replaced messy systems of social debt and obligation.

punchline.text: We never really traded fish for wheat.

quiz.question: What does barter require both parties to have?
